greek.palette: bronze impact, marble resonance, heroic breath, mythic beast growls
greek.mix_target: clear combat readability with strong low-mid body and short mythic accents

egyptian.palette: dry sand scrape, gold chime, jackal breath, tomb air, sun flare
egyptian.mix_target: ancient, dry, percussive sounds with readable divine accents

nordic.palette: ice crack, cold wind, iron hit, bone rattle, rune hum
nordic.mix_target: heavy cold transients, low rumble, and sparse ritual texture

chinese.palette: jade bell, silk wind, talisman snap, stone guardian grind, dragon breath
chinese.mix_target: bright upper accents over grounded creature body sounds

atlantean.palette: water pressure, crystal shimmer, orichalcum resonance, abyss pulse
atlantean.mix_target: aquatic lowpass movement with luminous crystal/technology accents

final_acceptance_shared: No event clips peak above -1 dBFS after export.
Ambient, hurt, death, attack and special/fly/charge events are distinguishable in combat.
Civilization palette is audible without masking vanilla Minecraft feedback.
Subtitle text matches the audible event and creature identity.
Loop-free one-shot events have clean starts and tails with no clicks.

minotaur.sonic_identity: bull-headed brute with stone arena footwork and aggressive breath

event_intents.ambient: low bull snort and chest rumble
event_intents.hurt: short angry bellow with body impact
event_intents.death: heavy fall with fading horned beast breath
event_intents.charge: hoof acceleration and forward body rush

acceptance_criteria: charge must read as attack replacement
low end should not hide player hits
arena brute identity must remain clear

event_intents.death: large body collapse with stone debris

acceptance_criteria: club attack must be heavier than normal hit
stone throw should be readable at distance
